$comment: BC Transit's connected South Okanagan-Similkameen (15), Kelowna (47), and North Okanagan/Shuswap (14) systems, merged so their transfers show together. Consat operator ids and current coverage checked 2026-10-28. The feed id remains bc-transit-kelowna for existing data URLs. Every route is drawn; overrides: routes.json. Region: central-okanagan, displayed as Okanagan. Terms: https://www.bctransit.com/open-data/terms-of-use/ (identify BC Transit as the source; no use of its marks).
name: BC Transit (Okanagan and Shuswap)

static.$comment: Consat exports one system per request, so fetch-gtfs merges these parts, each as its own agency (packages/data/src/gtfs-merge.ts). Consat ids are global across systems. The merged timetable covers only dates every part covers; on 2026-10-28 Kelowna ended 2026-12-19, South Okanagan 2027-09-06, and North Okanagan/Shuswap 2027-12-31. Daily exports roll off past dates (config/regions/central-okanagan/OPEN-QUESTIONS.md #1).

realtime.$comment: One request covers all three systems; endpoints accept multiple operatorIds. No API key or stated request limit. Polled within a modest budget: config/regions/central-okanagan/OPEN-QUESTIONS.md #2.
realtime.$poll: Guess, to be polite to a provider that states no limit: positions every 30 s while buses run (05:00-24:00), every 60 s overnight; trip updates every 2 minutes, 5 overnight; alerts every 5 minutes, 15 overnight. About 3,460 requests a day across all three systems; dailyCap is a safety net. OPEN-QUESTIONS #2.
realtime.$staleGraceS: Clients fall back to schedule estimates once live data is this much older than the positions poll interval (guess, OPEN-QUESTIONS #2).
realtime.$coverageSlackS: Recorder coverage breaks when snapshots are further apart than the positions poll interval plus this (guess, OPEN-QUESTIONS #2).
realtime.$interpolateSlackS: Interpolate between two fixes at most the positions poll interval plus this apart (guess, OPEN-QUESTIONS #2).
realtime.$extrapolateSlackS: Predict a bus forward for at most the positions poll interval plus this (fixes are fresher than TransLink's: p50 ~8 s, max ~60 s old when fetched; guess, OPEN-QUESTIONS #2).

display.$tripId: Consat trip ids begin with the journey id, as in BC Transit's other feeds.
display.$feedVersion: Versions begin with an export date and sequence number, before slash-separated export times.
